name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Onboarding & Customer Success Specialist
summary: Customer-facing professional with a strong track record in high-volume onboarding, appointment setting, and persistent client follow-up across CRM-driven sales and support environments. Comfortable on the phone, organized across many customers at once, and skilled at keeping people moving through a structured process to completion. Experienced across multiple CRM platforms and quick to learn new systems.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary client relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface goals, objectives, and challenges.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in CRM systems, keeping records accurate and current across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 business customers, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated follow-up sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Guided customers through technical setup and platform configuration by phone and email, resolving issues directly.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ customers per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Served as primary point of contact through onboarding and launch, delivering on time and accelerating time-to-value.

experience.title: Business Development Representative
bullets: Prospected and qualified leads by phone, booking appointments for sales representatives and maintaining a steady flow of confirmed meetings.
Followed up persistently on unconfirmed prospects to keep the appointment pipeline full and on schedule.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
